LEFT JOIN plt_dynamic_form_template_revision d ON d.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND d.template_id = t.id AND d.status_code = 'DRAFT' AND d.draft_marker = 1 AND d.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN plt_dynamic_form_template_revision p ON p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND p.template_id = t.id AND p.id = t.current_published_revision_id AND p.status_code = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted = b'0'

template_name = #{update.templateName}, category_code = #{update.categoryCode}, description = #{update.description}, availability_code = #{update.availabilityCode},
